fields.schemeName: Union Home Minister’s Medal for Excellence in Police Training
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to recognize the crucial role of trainers and support staff in police organizations, making training a respectable assignment and promoting high quality in police training institutes. It provides recognition, a Certificate (Scroll), and a cash reward of ₹25,000/- to trainers.

fields.schemeName: Tribals Development Plan: Purchase of Tourist Taxi
fields.briefDescription: This sub-scheme aims to empower Scheduled Tribe (ST) families by providing financial assistance to purchase tourist taxis for self-employment in Goa’s growing tourism industry. It supports tribal households in transitioning from traditional occupations to sustainable livelihood opportunities.

fields.schemeName: Promotion of Post-Harvest Management, Processing, and Value Addition of Aromatic Plant Produce to Farmers/Institutions/Groups in the State - Centre for Aromatic Plants
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage and support farmers, institutions, and groups engaged in aromatic plant cultivation to establish post-harvest management and processing facilities.

fields.schemeName: Quality Test Report - Centre for Aromatic Plants
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide quality testing facilities at a subsidized rate to registered aromatic farmers, enabling them to obtain authentic quality reports for their produce or essential oils.

fields.schemeName: Training Classes In Veda/Devaram
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to conduct training classes in Veda, Devaram, and Nalayira Divya Prabantham for divine worship/Poojas. It benefits eligible candidates by providing religious training in Saivaite and Vainavaite temples, and provides an honorarium of ₹1,000/- per month to the instructing pandits.

fields.schemeName: Lakhpati Didi Yojana - Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The primary objective of the scheme is to improve the economic status of women in Uttarakhand by empowering them to become financially self-reliant and achieve the status of “Lakhpati Didis.”

fields.schemeName: Grants-in-aid and Monthly Grants to Soldiers Decorated With Gallantry Decorations
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides a grant of ₹20,00,000–₹12,000 and a monthly allowance of ₹5,000–₹1,500 to gallantry awardees as a mark of honor and recognition for their valor.

fields.schemeName: E-Rickshaw Kalyan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among unemployed youth in the state by providing affordable loans for purchase of e-rickshaws, thereby enhancing their livelihoods. Under this scheme, loans are provided to unemployed youth for purchase of e-rickshaws at an annual interest rate of 9%.

fields.schemeName: Goa (Subsidy to Clay Idol Makers) Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage Goan artisans to continue traditional clay idol making by providing a subsidy of ₹100/- per idol, supporting registered local craftsmen in preserving cultural heritage and ensuring livelihood sustainability.

fields.schemeName: Revised Scheme For Incentives To Milk Producers
fields.briefDescription: BRIEF DESCRIPTION: The scheme aims to encourage farmers and youth in Goa to take up Dairy business to increase local milk production and achieve state self-sufficiency. It offers a 40% composite subsidy on milk proceeds (incentive and cattle feed subsidy) to eligible resident farmers.

fields.schemeName: National Food Security Scheme (Antyodaya Anna Yojana - Pink Ration Card) - Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure food security for the poorest and most vulnerable families by providing them with subsidized food grains under the Antyodaya category in the state. Under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive 35 kg of food grains and 1 kg of sugar per ration card at subsidized rates.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for SSI / MSI Sector (PIPDIC)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to extend financial support to establish new, or expand/modernize existing, Small Scale Industry and Medium Scale Industry units. Benefits include term loans up to ₹10,00,00,000/- for fixed asset acquisition.

fields.schemeName: Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM): Self-Employment Programme – Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote sustainable livelihoods and economic empowerment of the urban poor by providing financial support and guidance for establishing self-employment ventures, strengthening their family’s economy, and generating new employment opportunities.

fields.schemeName: Aawasiy Suvidha 1 – Indralok Aawasiy Yojana (Group Housing)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide residential facilities to homeless families through a registration process and lottery-based allotment.

fields.schemeName: Distribution of Materials to Promote Herbal Cultivation in Uttarakhand - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, there is a special provision for the free distribution of seeds or saplings of medicinal plants up to 3 nali and seeds or saplings of aromatic plants up to 5 nali to farmers belonging to border districts, Scheduled Castes/Tribes, and Below Poverty Line (BPL) categories.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to the Family of Temple Employees
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to grant financial assistance to the family of the temple employee who expires while in service. The scheme provides an amount of ₹5,000/- under the Group Insurance Scheme and an amount of ₹20,000/- under the Chief Minister’s Welfare Fund. The applications are accepted offline.

fields.schemeName: Financial Incentives for Certification and Intellectual Property Rights Reimbursement Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial incentives to industrial units, hospitals, and educational institutions in the State of Goa to obtain quality certifications and register Intellectual Property Rights, thereby enhancing their competitive strength in global markets and promoting innovation.

fields.schemeName: Issuing Legal Production Certificate (LPC) to Producers of Medicinal Plant Products for Export - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to facilitate the lawful export of endangered and CITES-listed medicinal plant species such as Kuth, Kutki, etc. by issuing Legal Production Certificates (LPC) to cultivators who legally grow these species on their own measured land.

fields.schemeName: Registration of Herb Cultivators - Herbal Research and Development Institute, Uttarakhand
fields.briefDescription: It aims to register cultivators who grow medicinal and aromatic plants, make the process of using their cultivated herbs easier, and stop the illegal collection of herbs from forests.

fields.schemeName: Mushroom Production and Marketing Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote mushroom cultivation among farmers by providing subsidized inputs, training, and support for marketing, thereby increasing their income and encouraging entrepreneurship in the sector.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Purchase of Battery Operated Vehicles
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to eligible residents of Puducherry for the purchase of Battery-Operated vehicles. The scheme provides financial support, including an investment subsidy of ₹80,000/- provided by the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy, Govt. of India.

fields.schemeName: Scheme Of Assistance To Good Borrowers: ‘A’ Category
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide special financial assistance to existing good borrowers who have maintained an excellent track record of timely repayment. Benefits include term loans up to ₹150,00,000/- and an interest rate concession of 1% less than the normal rate for modernization, expansion, etc.

fields.schemeName: Scheme Of Assistance To Women Entrepreneurs (Mahalir Udavi)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to extend financial assistance to new or existing Micro Enterprises and Small Scale Industry units exclusively promoted by women or having a majority of women entrepreneurs. It provides term loans and working capital assistance up to 75% of the project cost.

fields.schemeName: Scheme of Assistance to SC/ST Entrepreneurs
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to extend financial assistance to SC/ST Entrepreneurs for setting up new Micro Enterprises or for expansion of existing units. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.

fields.schemeName: Scheme for Marketing Organisations
fields.briefDescription: The scheme was launched by PIPDIC, Department of Industries & Commerce, Puducherry. The scheme aims to financially assist entrepreneurs for setting up entrepreneurs setting up of hotel/restaurant projects in urban areas. The applications for this scheme are accepted online through the PIPDIC portal.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Chhaatrvrtti Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support eligible NCC cadets through financial incentives to encourage continued participation in education and NCC training. Under this scheme, scholarship amounts ranging from ₹600/- to ₹2,400/- are provided annually to eligible NCC cadets at group and unit levels.

fields.schemeName: Mukhyamantri Aanchal Amrit Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to improve the health of children between 3 to 6 years of age by providing them fortified and flavored milk containing Vitamins A and D, four days a week, at Anganwadi Centres.

fields.schemeName: Integrated Toll Free 104 Helpline
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide the general public with round-the-clock (24×7×365) access to reliable health information and medical advice through the toll-free number 104.

fields.schemeName: Nishulk Ganavesh Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide free uniforms to all girl students studying in Classes 1 to 8 of government and government-aided schools, as well as to all boys belonging to Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes, and boys from the General category who fall under the BPL category.

fields.schemeName: Sanskrit Chhaatr Pratiyogita
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote Sanskrit education among students by organizing Sanskrit competitions at various levels. Under this scheme, Sanskrit competitions are organized at various levels for both junior (Class 6 to 10) and senior (Class 11 to post-graduation) categories.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance to Permanent Residents of Uttarakhand for Religious Pilgrimages
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹50,000/- to permanent residents of the state who have successfully completed the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra, irrespective of their religion or caste.

fields.schemeName: Paalna Ghar (Crèche)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide day care facilities for children aged 6 months to 6 years of working couples at a nominal monthly fee in Crèches.

fields.schemeName: Livelihood Opportunity Promotion Scheme (Scheduled Tribes)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among Scheduled Tribe individuals through financial support, including loans, margin money, and grants.

fields.schemeName: Minority Scholarship Scheme for Class 1 to 10
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide scholarships to students belonging to minority communities who are studying in Classes 1 to 10 in any recognized government/non-government educational institution in Uttarakhand.

fields.schemeName: Assistance for Purchase of Traditional Musical Instruments and Costumes for Scheduled Caste/Tribe Individuals
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support scheduled caste and scheduled tribe individuals whose livelihood depends on traditional arts by providing them with essential musical instruments and costumes.

fields.schemeName: Out of Turn Employment to Sportspersons in State Services
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide job opportunities to medal-winning sportspersons of Uttarakhand, who have represented the state in international and national games, by offering them out-of-turn employment in various state services.

fields.schemeName: Dr. V.N. Mathur Award (M.Sc. Mathematics)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support and encourage meritorious students pursuing an M.Sc. in Mathematics, thereby assisting them and reducing their financial burden. The assistance of ₹20,000/- per year is provided to eligible students.

fields.schemeName: Swanath Scholarship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to diploma and graduate-level students who are orphans, whose parents or either parent has died due to COVID-19, or who are dependents of martyrs from the military or central armed forces.

fields.schemeName: Research Assistantship
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide research assistantship to undergraduate and postgraduate research scholars to support their academic and research activities.

fields.schemeName: Samaaveshit Shiksha
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide equal and inclusive educational opportunities to all children with special needs (Divyang children) studying in government schools from Classes 1 to 12.

fields.schemeName: Sponsorship for Employment
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide employment opportunities to ex-servicemen and their legal dependents by sponsoring them for contractual posts. Under this scheme, eligible candidates are sponsored for various departmental positions based on demand and their qualifications.

fields.schemeName: Allotment of Commercial Shops
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote ease of doing business for licensed traders by providing them with well-located commercial shops in market yards (mandis).

fields.schemeName: Son/Daughter Education Assistance (UKBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme provides financial assistance to the children of registered building and construction workers pursuing education from Class I up to higher education or professional courses.

fields.schemeName: Seemant Parvatiya Janpad Baal Vigyan Mahotsav
fields.briefDescription: It aims to provide students from classes 6 to 12 of government/non-government schools in six border districts of the state (Uttarkashi, Chamoli, Rudraprayag, Champawat, Bageshwar,Pithoragarh) with an opportunity to participate in science competitions & to promote scientific awareness in these areas.

fields.schemeName: Old Age Pension Scheme- On Completion Of 65 Years (UKBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide a monthly pension of ₹1,500/- to construction workers registered with the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board who have attained the age of 65 years.

fields.schemeName: Labour Card and Renewal of Labour Card
fields.briefDescription: Under  this facilities, a labour card is issued to workers engaged in construction, repair, maintenance, and related activities, enabling them to avail the benefits of all welfare schemes provided by the Uttarakhand Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare

fields.schemeName: Motorcycle Taxi Yojana
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote self-employment among the residents of Uttarakhand by providing interest-free loans for purchasing motorcycles or scooters to operate as motorcycle taxis, thereby enhancing tourism connectivity and generating livelihood opportunities in the state.

fields.schemeName: Procedure for Making Medical Certificate (for Certifying Disability)
fields.briefDescription: The certificate aims to ensure that persons with disabilities can easily obtain authentic medical certification required to avail benefits under various social welfare schemes, including disability pensions, scholarships, healthcare facilities, and employment reservations.

fields.schemeName: Maternity Financial Assistance (UKBOCWWB)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial support to registered women construction workers during the maternity period. This assistance is admissible only for the birth of up to two children.

fields.schemeName: Akhil Bharatiya Samanvit Anusandhan Pariyojana - Veer Chandra Singh Garhwali Uttarakhand University of Horticulture and Forestry
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to conduct research and improve important horticultural and forestry species, conserve their germplasm, provide improved seeds and saplings, and train farmers in using better techniques to enhance productivity.
